_comment: Fixed v0.2 bundle-table ABI for other patches (e.g. per-profile WB). Section-1 FF tail; section 1 loads before every other section. Checked by patches/bundles/build.py.

hue: s8 x12, UI -7..7, UI sector order
grain: u8 0 off,1 low,2 medium,3 high; read by patches/grain v0.4 (COLOR slots; other values = off)
wb_flags: bit0 = override WB fine-tune; bit7 must be 0 (0xFF = erased, ignored by patches/wb)
effect_strength: u8 1..5 when effect_id != 0; bloom (id 1) read by patches/bloom v0.4 (other values = off)
flags: bit0 render colour (MONO, mirror of colour), bit1 H/L enabled
colour: u8: exactly 1 = MONO slot renders in colour (patches/mono_colour); any other value = stock mono
sat: s8 x12, -5..5, request+1816 order (as the COLOR profile saturation); read only when colour == 1

job_extension.note: valid only behind the callback/record/parent guard; marker != 0xB2 means no capture record
